description: Search EU public procurement notices (tenders, contract notices, awards) on TED through the official API v3: keywords, optional buyer country and open-deadline filter, newest first. Free: the 25 newest matches. With bulk=true or page: 100 notices per page, pages 1-50, for $0.002 USDC. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

bulk.description: true = paid tier (100 notices per page).

country.description: Optional buyer country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EU/EEA + CH), e.g. "FR".

open_only.description: true = only notices whose tender deadline has not passed.

page.description: Paid tier: result page of 100 notices.

q.description: Keywords; a comma separates alternatives (OR), up to 5, e.g. "cloud hosting,data centre".

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.

name: ted_tender_search
title: EU public tender search (TED)
